remarks: Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a spacious 3-bedroom corner townhouse in the highly sought-after Sunrise Hill complex! Offering over 2,000 sq ft across three levels, this home features a finished lower level. On the main level sliders open to a private deck and a fenced yard. The main floor boasts a generous living area with built-ins and a cozy fireplace. Upstairs, you'll find a large primary suite with two closets, plus two additional bedrooms and a full bath. The lower-level family room is perfect for a quiet time with a book and there is also an extra room for an office or guest space. This end unit is filled with natural light and scenic pool views. Sunrise Hill provides resort-like amenities, including a pool, tennis courts, and a playground. Ideally located in the heart of Norwalk, with easy access to highways, SoNo restaurants, the Metro-North station, and the SoNo Collection Mall. Move in and start enjoying this vibrant community! We are in multiple offers situation. We are asking for highest and best offer by Thursday, September 26th at 5pm.
